WITH media_stats AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name,
         AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM media_stats
)
SELECT ms.media_type_name,
       ms.avg_unit_price,
       ms.avg_bytes_per_ms,
       ms.avg_bytes_per_ms / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall_avg
FROM media_stats ms
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;
